name: KitchenAid
legalEntityNote: KitchenAid is a consumer brand in Whirlpool Corporation's portfolio. Official KitchenAid terms identify Whirlpool Properties, Inc. as the KitchenAid trademark owner in the cited market. Major appliances, countertop appliances and licensed categories can use different operating, manufacturing, sales and warranty entities by model and country.
headline: KitchenAid ownership, trademark, manufacturing and category boundaries
description: A source-backed profile separating Whirlpool ownership, the KitchenAid trademark, major and countertop appliances, licensed categories, Greenville manufacturing and warranty responsibility.
metaDescription: KitchenAid brand profile: Whirlpool ownership, trademark, small and major appliances, manufacturing, licensing, channels and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with KitchenAid or Whirlpool Corporation. Evidence for a named KitchenAid plant or product category should not be generalized to every appliance, market, licensee or warranty.
headquarters: Benton Harbor, Michigan, United States (Whirlpool Corporation and Global Small Domestic Appliances)

ownership.summary: KitchenAid is part of Whirlpool Corporation's current brand portfolio. Official KitchenAid terms identify Whirlpool Properties, Inc. as the registered trademark owner in the cited market. Whirlpool Corporation expressly retained its EMEA KitchenAid small- and major-domestic-appliance business when Beko Europe was formed, so Beko Europe's regional Whirlpool licence does not transfer KitchenAid ownership.

productPortfolio.name: Stand mixers and attachments
productPortfolio.positioning: The iconic stand mixer anchors KitchenAid's premium culinary identity, supported by attachments and accessories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify model compatibility, voltage, bowl and attachment standards, origin, parts and authorized regional warranty.

productPortfolio.name: Countertop appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Current ranges include blenders, hand mixers, food processors, espresso, grain and rice cookers and cordless appliances.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not assign the entire range to Greenville; check the legal manufacturer and origin for each model family.

productPortfolio.name: Major kitchen appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: KitchenAid sells refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, ovens, cooktops, microwaves, undercounter products and ventilation in selected markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Use model-level factory, installation, conformity, parts and warranty evidence from the destination market.

productPortfolio.name: Licensed categories
productPortfolio.positioning: Whirlpool Corporation lists KitchenAid outdoor grills and barbecue accessories among licensed product categories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm licensee authorization, territory, manufacturer and warranty instead of assuming a Whirlpool plant.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation states that its Greenville, Ohio plant makes KitchenAid small appliances including the iconic stand mixer.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the model label before extending Greenville origin to a particular stand mixer or other small appliance.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation operates multiple North American major-appliance factories and reports U.S. portfolio-level domestic production.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Whirlpool Corporation major-appliance network, not a KitchenAid-only plant assignment
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require exact KitchenAid model origin, manufacturer and factory documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: KitchenAid-branded licensed categories can be manufactured and warranted by approved licensees.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Product categories listed by Whirlpool Corporation licensing
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Obtain the licence scope and identify the licensee, plant, seller and warranty provider.

marketsChannels.evidence: KitchenAid's official U.S. site separates major appliances, countertop appliances and their service contacts.
marketsChannels.scope: KitchenAid U.S. direct and service channels
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the correct product-category contact and confirm authorized retail or distribution status.

marketsChannels.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation retained its EMEA KitchenAid small- and major-appliance business in the Beko Europe transaction.
marketsChannels.scope: EMEA KitchenAid ownership and operating boundary
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not route KitchenAid sourcing or warranty requests to Beko Europe solely because it licenses Whirlpool.

marketsChannels.evidence: Official KitchenAid warranties name different Whirlpool entities and guarantors by product category and market.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Retain the invoice, model-specific warranty and local service terms before cross-border resale.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: KitchenAid combines a globally recognized premium culinary brand with Whirlpool Corporation's major- and small-appliance capabilities. Its breadth makes category control essential: a stand mixer, refrigerator and licensed grill can carry the same trademark but follow different manufacturing and warranty chains.

developments.title: Whirlpool launches the KitchenAid Artisan Plus
developments.summary: Whirlpool Corporation's 2025 annual report names the Artisan Plus among 2026 product launches, reinforcing KitchenAid's global small-appliance role.

developments.title: Whirlpool retains EMEA KitchenAid in the Beko Europe transaction
developments.summary: The official closing announcement expressly retained both small and major KitchenAid appliance activities in EMEA.

developments.title: KitchenAid stand mixer launches
developments.summary: KitchenAid traces its brand heritage to the launch of the stand mixer in 1919.
